channel.title: Farsçadan (English)
channel.description: AI-assisted English translations of selected stories from Iran's Persian-language press. Every story notes the outlet's political orientation.

item.title: Who decides in Iran? A map of six institutions and their powers
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: Guide to the powers of the Supreme Leader, President, Parliament, Guardian Council, Expediency Council, and Assembly of Experts, with sources. (Source: Farsçadan)

item.title: U.S. Senate rejects resolution to limit Trump's Iran war powers again
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: Senate votes 48-51 to reject resolution restricting Trump's Iran military ops; Pennsylvania Democrat Fetterman broke ranks. This is the 12th vote this year. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Riyadh's tallest tower hit in Houthi attack; Saudis confirm damage
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: Saudi civil defense confirmed a tower in Riyadh's financial center was struck in a Houthi attack; no casualties reported. (Source: Donya-ye Eqtesad)

item.title: Iran strikes back at Vienna: won't return to pre-war inspection terms
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: Iran's IAEA representative criticized the agency's silence on U.S.-Israeli strikes; U.S. and three European nations demanded inspectors return. (Source: Ettelaat)

item.title: Iran tries oil exports through blockade? TankerTrackers claim lacks confirmation
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: TankerTrackers claimed Iran is preparing to resume crude oil exports despite naval blockade; no official confirmation received. (Source: Donya-ye Eqtesad)

item.title: Pezeshkian says "I sleep in a coat," gets sharp backlash from struggling citizens
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: Iran's President Pezeshkian said he sleeps in a coat without heat as an example of energy conservation; struggling citizens attacked the remark on social media. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Iran's press map: which newspaper, which faction's voice?
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: From IRNA to Kayhan, from Hamshahri to Iran International: a map of Iranian media's ownership and political orientation. (Source: Farsçadan)

item.title: Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral summit in Shenzhen begins; Trump says he doesn't need their help on Iran
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: Trump, Xi, and Putin to hold trilateral talks in Shenzhen within APEC; Trump says he doesn't need their aid to end Iran war. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: New incident in Hormuz: Unidentified object strikes tanker off Oman coast
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: UKMTO reports unidentified object struck a tanker exiting the Strait of Hormuz; cause remains unclear. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: UN Third Committee approves Iran human rights resolution; vote count disputed
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: UN General Assembly Third Committee passed Canada-led Iran human rights resolution 76-27-64; Iranian and opposition press split on framing. (Source: Ettelaat)

item.title: Missile wave from Yemen at Riyadh and Jeddah: airport operations halted
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: Houthi forces claim they targeted Riyadh airport, financial center, and Jeddah airport with missile barrage that halted operations. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Abadan protest's second act: Kayhan labels demonstrators 'enemy tools,' solidarity messages continue
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: Kayhan claims Abadan bus-crash protest is 'enemy-directed'; opposition press documents solidarity messages and protest slogans. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: Explosions in Bahrain and Kuwait: U.S.-Iran escalation cycle intensifies
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: According to IRNA, alarm sirens sounded in Bahrain and Kuwait; IRGC and U.S. made mutual strike claims as tensions escalate. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Iran: CNN and NYT dam stories are disinformation campaign
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: According to Ettelaat, Iran's Foreign Ministry called CNN's chemical weapons claim and NYT's dam report false and war crime material. (Source: Ettelaat)

item.title: CENTCOM Commander Cooper's tour: Tel Aviv first, then Saudi Arabia with 36 advisors
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: According to Hamshahri, CENTCOM Commander Cooper visited Tel Aviv; IRGC spokesman mocked claimed 75 drone losses to Iran. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Pakistan man sentenced to 27.5 years for IRGC-linked Trump assassination plot
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: According to ISNA, the U.S. sentenced a Pakistani national linked to the IRGC to 27.5 years for plotting former President Trump's assassination. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Abdanan worker bus crash: 13 dead, manager removed, protests erupt
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: According to Ettelaat, 13 engineers died when a worker bus overturned near Abdanan; facility manager was removed and protests began. (Source: Ettelaat)

item.title: CNN reports Iran planning "dirty bomb" attacks on Trump administration officials
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: Based on seven U.S. officials, CNN reports Iran is planning attacks on senior Trump administration members; U.S. officials disagree on Iran's capability. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Bahrain's Sheikh Isa Qassim sentenced to life: news timeline conflicts with court schedule
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: Kayhan reported Sheikh Isa Qassim and 48 scholars sentenced to life imprisonment, but other sources say the verdict was postponed to Nov. 22. (Source: Kayhan)

item.title: Flights halted at Riyadh airport; drone attack from Yemen reported
item.dc:creator: Farsçadan Editors
item.description: According to Hamshahri, flight operations at Riyadh's King Khalid Airport were suspended following a reported drone attack from Yemen. (Source: Hamshahri)
